spans.s: एक pron. (f. का) 1. One, single; 2. unique, singular; 3. preeminent, excellent; 4. same, identical; 5. one of two or many, Megh.i.30, ii.15; 6. a, an (used as an indefinite article); 7. alone, only, Bhartr.iii.14; 8. unparalleled, peerless.(एक-अन्य or अपर ‘the one-the other,’ ‘some-others.’)

एक pron. (f. का) 1. One, single; 2. unique, singular; 3. preeminent, excellent; 4. same, identical; 5. one of two or many, Megh.i.30, ii.15; 6. a, an (used as an indefinite article); 7. alone, only, Bhartr.iii.14; 8. unparalleled, peerless.(एक-अन्य or अपर ‘the one-the other,’ ‘some-others.’)
एक-अक्ष (I) a. 1. having only one axle; 2. having one eye.
एक-अक्ष (II) m. a crow.
एक-अग्र, -अग्र्य a. 1. closely attentive, e.g. एकाग्रमासीनम्; 2. undisturbed; 3. single-pointed.
एक-अग्र, -अग्र्य a. 1. closely attentive, e.g. एकाग्रमासीनम्; 2. undisturbed; 3. single-pointed.
एक-अंग m. 1. a body-guard; 2. the planet Mercury.
एक-अनुदिष्ट n. a funeral ceremony performed only for one ancestor.
एक-अन्त (I) m. 1. the exclusive aim or boundary; 2. a secret place; 3. monotheism.
एक-अन्त (II) n. exclusive recourse, तेजः क्षामा वा नैकान्तं कालज्ञस्य महीपतेः Sis.ii.83.
एक-अन्त (III) a. 1. invariable, perpetual, स्वायत्तमेकान्तगुणं (छादनम्) Bhartr.ii.7; 2. excessive. (एकान्तम् ind. means ‘exceedingly.’)
एक-अन्ततस् ind. thoroughly, wholly, Bhartr.iii.24, कस्यान्त्यंतं सुखमुपनतं दुःखमेकान्ततो वा Megh.ii.46.
एक-अन्तर a. next but one.
एक-अन्तिक a. final, conclusive.
एक-अयन (I) a. 1. closely attentive; 2. passable by one only.
एक-अयन (II) n. 1. a meeting place; 2. monotheism.
एक-अयन˚गत a. See एकायन a.
एक-अर्थ m. 1. the same intention; 2. the same thing; 3. the same meaning.
एक-अह m. the period of one day.
एक-आतपत्र a. characterised by one umbrella (referring to universal sovereignty), एकातपत्रं जगतः प्रभुत्वम् R.ii.47.
एक-आदेश m. one substitute for two or more letters, as in the case of the word मुरारि.
एक-देश m. a portion or division of a whole.

एक-आवली f. 1. a single string of pearls &c., एकावली कण्ठविभूषणं वः Vikr.Ch.i.30; 2. the name of a figure, thus defined- स्थाप्यतेऽपोह्यते वापि यथापूर्वं परम्परम् । विशेषणतया यत्र वस्तु सैकावली K.Pr.x. (in rhetoric).
एक-कर a. 1. one-handed; 2. one-rayed.
एक-कार्य (I) a. having the same occupation.
एक-कार्य (II) n. sole business.
एक-काल m. 1. one time; 2. the same time.
एक-कालीन a. contemporaneous.
एक-कुण्डल m. an epithet (1) of Kubera; (2) of Balabhadra; (3) of Śeṣa.
एक-गुरु a. having the same preceptor.
एक-चक्र (I) a. 1. having only one wheel; 2. governed by only one king.
एक-चक्र (II) m. the chariot of the Sun.
एक-चर a. 1. wandering alone; 2. living unassisted.
एक-चारिणी f. a loyal wife.
एक-चित्त n. fixedness of thought on one object.
एक-चेतस्, -मनस् a. unanimous.
एक-चेतस्, -मनस् a. unanimous.
एक-जन्मन् m. 1. a king, a sovereign; 2. a Śūdra.
एक-जात a. born of the same parents.
एक-जाति m.f. a Śūdra. (ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वैश्यस्त्रयो वर्णा द्विजातयः । चतुर्थ एकजातस्तु शुद्रो नास्ति तु पञ्चमः.)
एक-जातीय a. belonging to the same family, of the same kind.
एक-ज्योतिस् m. an epithet of Śiva.
एक-तम a. (f. मा, n. मत्) 1. one of many; 2. one.
एक-तम a. (f. मा, n. मत्) 1. one of many; 2. one.
एक-तम a. (f. मा, n. मत्) 1. one of many; 2. one.
एक-तर a. (f. तरा, n. रत्) 1. one of two, either; 2. one of many.
एक-तर a. (f. तरा, n. रत्) 1. one of two, either; 2. one of many.
एक-तर a. (f. तरा, n. रत्) 1. one of two, either; 2. one of many.
एक-तान a. closely attentive to one thing, प्रश्नैकतानमनसो हि वसिष्ठमिश्राः Mv.iii.
एक-ताल m. the accurate and continuous adjustment of song, dance, and instrumental music.
एक-तीर्थिन् (I) m. a spiritual brother, a fellow-student.
एक-तीर्थिन् (II) a. belonging to the same religious order, Yaj.ii.137.
एक-दंष्ट्र m. a name of Gaṇeśa.

एक-दंडिन् m. designation of a class of sannyāsins otherwise called हंस. The following stanza from Hārīta gives four orders of sannyāsins - कुटीचको बहुदको हंसश्चैव तृतीयकः । चतुर्थः परहंसश्च यो यः पश्चात् स उत्तमः.
एक-दंत m. a name of Gaṇeśa.
एक-दृश्, -दृष्टि m. 1. a crow; 2. a philosopher.
एक-दृश्, -दृष्टि m. 1. a crow; 2. a philosopher.
एक-देश˚विभावितन्याय m. an inference as to the whole when proof is given of a part. (Cf. विभावितैकदेशेन देयं यदभियुज्यते Vikr.iv.)
एक-धर्मन् a. 1. having the same properties; 2. professing the same religion.
एक-धुर, -धुरावह, -धुरीण a. 1. fit for a single yoke; 2. fit for but one kind of labour.
एक-धुर, -धुरावह, -धुरीण a. 1. fit for a single yoke; 2. fit for but one kind of labour.
एक-धुर, -धुरावह, -धुरीण a. 1. fit for a single yoke; 2. fit for but one kind of labour.
एक-नट m. a principal actor in a drama.
एक-पक्ष m. 1. an assistant; 2. one side or party.
एक-पत्नी f. 1. a faithful wife, तां चावश्यं दिवसगणनातत्परामेकपत्नीम् Megh.i.10; 2. a co-wife, सर्वातामेकपत्नीनामेका चेत् पुत्रिणी भवेत्.
एक-पदे ind. suddenly, कथमेकपदे निरागतम् R.viii.48.
एक-पदी f. a path.
एक-पाद m. an epithet (1) of Viṣṇu, (2) of Śiva.
एक-पिंग, -पिंगल m. an epithet of Kubera.
एक-पिंग, -पिंगल m. an epithet of Kubera.
एक-पिंड m. united by the offering of the funeral cake.
एक-भार्या f. a faithful wife.
एक-यष्टि, -यष्टिका f. a single string of pearls.
एक-यष्टि, -यष्टिका f. a single string of pearls.
एक-योनि a. 1. uterine; 2. of the same family.
एक-राज्, -राज m. an absolute king.
एक-राज्, -राज m. an absolute king.
एक-रात्र n. one night.
एक-रिक्थिन् m. a co-heir.
एक-लिंग m. 1. a word having one gender only; 2. an epithet of Kubera.
एक-वचन n. the singular number.
एक-वर्षिका f. a heifer one year old.
एक-वाक्यता f. consistency in meaning, unanimity.
एक-वारम्, -वारे ind. 1. only once; 2. at one time; 3. suddenly.
एक-वारम्, -वारे ind. 1. only once; 2. at one time; 3. suddenly.
एक-विलोचन m. 1. Kubera; 2. a crow.
एक-विषयिन् m. a rival.
एक-वीर m. a preeminent warrior.
एक-वेणि, -वेणी f. the clotted hair of a woman in separation, गण्डाभोगात्कठिनविषमामेकवेणीं करेण Megh.ii.29.
एक-वेणि, -वेणी f. the clotted hair of a woman in separation, गण्डाभोगात्कठिनविषमामेकवेणीं करेण Megh.ii.29.
एक-शफ m. an animal whose hoof is not cloven.
एक-शरीरान्वय m. a Brāhmaṇa of the same branch or school.
एक-शृंग m. 1. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 2. a rhinoceros.
एक-शेष m. a kind of Dvandva compound in which only one of the members is retained, (e.g. पितरौ for मातापितरौ).
एक-श्रुतधर a. keeping in mind what has been heard only once.
एक-सर्ग a. closely attentive.
एक-साक्षिक a. witnessed by one.
एक-हायन a. one year old.
एक-हायनी, -अब्दा f. a heifer one year old.
एक-हायनी, -अब्दा f. a heifer one year old.
एकक a. (f. का) 1. Solitary, alone, without a coadjutor; 2. same, identical.
एकक a. (f. का) 1. Solitary, alone, without a coadjutor; 2. same, identical.
एकतस् ind. 1. From one side, on one side; 2. one by one.(एकतः-अन्यतः ‘on one side-on the other’ Kir.v.2.)
एकत्र ind. 1. In one place; 2. in a combined manner, together.
एकदा ind. 1. At the same time, at once; 2. once upon a time, एकदा हि तैः सुहृन्मन्त्रिपुरोहितैः D.K.
एकधा ind. 1. Singly; 2. together; 3. at once.
एकल a. (f. ला) Solitary, alone.
एकल a. (f. ला) Solitary, alone.
एकशस् ind. One by one.
एकाकिन् a. (f. नी) Solitary, alone.
एकाकिन् a. (f. नी) Solitary, alone.
